From eedbbb0d98b2a89250a8bb83d9c71b77881e5247 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Peter Oskolkov <posk@google.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Dec 2018 15:42:48 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: dccp: initialize (addr,port) listening hashtable

Commit d9fbc7f6431f "net: tcp: prefer listeners bound to an address"
removes port-only listener lookups. This caused segfaults in DCCP
lookups because DCCP did not initialize the (addr,port) hashtable.

This patch adds said initialization.

The only non-trivial issue here is the size of the new hashtable.
It seemed reasonable to make it match the size of the port-only
hashtable (= INET_LHTABLE_SIZE) that was used previously. Other
parameters to inet_hashinfo2_init() match those used in TCP.

V2 changes: marked inet_hashinfo2_init as an exported symbol
so that DCCP compiles when configured as a module.

Tested: syzcaller issues fixed; the second patch in the patchset
        tests that DCCP lookups work correctly.

Fixes: d9fbc7f6431f "net: tcp: prefer listeners bound to an address"
Reported-by: syzcaller <syzkaller@googlegroups.com>
Signed-off-by: Peter Oskolkov <posk@google.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/ipv4/inet_hashtables.c b/net/ipv4/inet_hashtables.c
index cd03ab42705b..2445614de6a7 100644
--- a/net/ipv4/inet_hashtables.c
+++ b/net/ipv4/inet_hashtables.c
@@ -785,6 +785,7 @@ void __init inet_hashinfo2_init(struct inet_hashinfo *h, const char *name,
 		h->lhash2[i].count = 0;
 	}
 }
+EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(inet_hashinfo2_init);
 
 int inet_ehash_locks_alloc(struct inet_hashinfo *hashinfo)
 {
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/net/dccp/proto.c b/net/dccp/proto.c
index 658cd32bb7b3..be0b223aa862 100644
--- a/net/dccp/proto.c
+++ b/net/dccp/proto.c
@@ -1141,6 +1141,9 @@ static int __init dccp_init(void)
 		goto out_fail;
 	rc = -ENOBUFS;
 	inet_hashinfo_init(&dccp_hashinfo);
+	inet_hashinfo2_init(&dccp_hashinfo, "dccp_listen_portaddr_hash",
+			    INET_LHTABLE_SIZE, 21,  /* one slot per 2 MB*/
+			    0, 64 * 1024);
 	dccp_hashinfo.bind_bucket_cachep =
 		kmem_cache_create("dccp_bind_bucket",
 				  sizeof(struct inet_bind_bucket), 0,

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/ipv4/inet_hashtables.c`**
   - Added the line `EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(inet_hashinfo2_init);` to export the `inet_hashinfo2_init` function, allowing it to be used by other modules.

2. **File: `net/dccp/proto.c`**
   - Added a call to `inet_hashinfo2_init(&dccp_hashinfo, "dccp_listen_portaddr_hash", INET_LHTABLE_SIZE, 21, 0, 64 * 1024);` within the `dccp_init` function. This initializes the (addr, port) hashtable for DCCP, using the same size as the previously used port-only hashtable.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `inet_hashtables.c` establishes the `inet_hashinfo2_init` function as an exported symbol, which is necessary for it to be accessible in other parts of the kernel, specifically in the DCCP module. The change in `proto.c` utilizes this exported function to initialize the DCCP (addr, port) hashtable, addressing the issue of uninitialized hashtable that led to segmentation faults during DCCP lookups. Thus, the changes are interdependent: the export allows the initialization to occur, which fixes the bug reported.

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/dccp/proto.c`**

The initialization of the (addr, port) listening hashtable in DCCP requires the `inet_hashinfo2_init()` function to be available for use. By exporting this function, the patch ensures that DCCP can successfully compile and utilize the new hashtable initialization, thereby fixing the segfault issues that arose from the lack of initialization after the previous TCP-related changes.
